artifact_review: The Router's identification of 'structural_collapse' in the stem/leaf attachments is the most critical finding. The background texture anomaly (severity 2.5) and slight floating effect (severity 1.5) are also valid observations supported by the geometric depth auditor's context and perceptual quality auditor's note on compression/smoothing.
